# KiCad MCP Cloud — public documentation for agents

> Managed MCP access for explicit, owner-approved KiCad project summaries, not a public tool to execute arbitrary local commands.

## Connection and authorization

Use https://kicad-mcp-pro.oaslananka.dev/mcp as the protected HTTPS MCP endpoint. Authenticate through the advertised OAuth Protected Resource Metadata at https://kicad-mcp-pro.oaslananka.dev/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. The authorization server is discovered from this metadata; do not assume an issuer at the site root.

Read operations require the projects:read scope and a separate owner-approved project grant. Unauthorized project identifiers are not discoverable. Registered devices may be offline; do not assume KiCad's GUI or any PCB tool is running.

## Common owner workflows

1. Sign in to the Cloud workspace.
2. On the owner's computer, run kicad-mcp-pro cloud setup to pair a device and select a local project folder.
3. Approve device pairing using the owner's first-party browser session.
4. Connect an AI client using the remote MCP URL and OAuth, not a shared static API key.
5. Grant each client access to an explicitly registered project.
6. Revoke client or project access independently when no longer needed.

The hosted MCP currently exposes read-only project presence and bounded summary/count tools when available. Write operations and manufacturing submission are not included in the hosted surface. Local KiCad file paths, project data and credentials are not published by this documentation.
